Result is a tuple string representation: (('COc1cccc(N)c1', 'Nc1c(C(=O)O)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1'),)

So precursors: 1) COc1cccc(N)c1 (p-anisidine) (actually aniline with methoxy). 2) Nc1c(C(=O)O)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1 (this is triazine with side chain and carboxylic acid). The second still contains the azetidine (N2CC(F)C2). Need to further disconnect that side chain using secondary amine template 480781.

Apply template 480781 to second precursor.
